seo.title: The Audacity · Agentic Engineering Studio
seo.description: An Agentic Engineering Studio: AI agents build, senior judgment owns architecture, security and quality. Idea to deployed product in weeks. Book a call.

hero.headline: Your product live in weeks, at a fixed price
hero.lede: We build the whole product: sign-up and login, database, and launch on the web or app stores, with payments and analytics when you need them. The price and deadline go in the contract before any code, and you pay per finished milestone.

proofTeaser.title: Proof starts with three products of our own
proofTeaser.body: Bloop is in build and piloting in Bologna. Washiiba is a laundry marketplace built end to end. Kerf is a case study on public data. Recovery Room is a pilot, live at a gym in Cagliari. Client work follows as it ships.

process.title: Three steps take your idea from agreed scope to production

steps.title: Scope
steps.body: We agree one outcome, a price and a deadline before any code is written.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: You see working software early and often. AI agents do the build. Senior judgment owns architecture, security and code review.

steps.title: Ship
steps.body: Your product goes live in production with automatic releases, ready for real users.

ctaBand.title: Tell us the idea that should already be live
ctaBand.body: Book a free 25-minute call. We tell you what it takes to ship it and whether we are the right studio. A fixed-price proposal follows within 2 business days.

seo.title: Work · Bloop, Washiiba, Kerf and Recovery Room · The Audacity
